litsteel.name: Lit Steel
litsteel.desc: While the Lamplighter's light powers him up, the Warden's hits set enemies on fire.

kindred.name: Kindred Flames
kindred.desc: Kindle lasts twice as long, and while he is Kindled he takes 20% less damage.

witness.name: Witness
witness.desc: Every enemy he Executes heals the Lamplighter and fills her Spark.

ward.name: Lantern Ward
ward.desc: Inside the Dome, all healing is doubled and the Dome lasts 1 second longer.

bond.name: Bond of Light
bond.desc: Your Bond fills twice as fast, and close together you heal three times faster.

ember.name: Ember Storm
ember.desc: Duo: while you stand close, her fireflies get pulled into his Whirlwind and everything it hits catches fire.

rod.name: Lightning Rod
rod.desc: Duo: while you stand close, his Thunder Clap sends her lightning through the whole crowd.

pax.name: Prismatic Axe
pax.desc: Duo: while you stand close, every Hurled Axe hit splits into rainbow bolts.

sanct.name: Sanctuary
sanct.desc: Duo: while you stand close, the War Banner heals you both and blooms with flowers.

phoenixrage.name: Blood Phoenix
phoenixrage.desc: Duo: while you stand close and his Blood Moon is up, her Phoenix burns twice as hard and every hit heals him.

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.desc: Duo: while you stand close, every Hellchains collision leaves a ring of fire behind.

verdictlight.name: Verdict of Light
verdictlight.desc: Duo: while you stand close, every Guillotine drop bursts with holy light that heals you both and hurts everything around it.

doomclock.name: Doom Clock
doomclock.desc: Duo: while you stand close, Death Knell freezes time instead of stunning, and Executes 10% more.
